caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, brown clay jar placed upright within a rectangular frame outlined in pencil or ink. The jar has a rounded body that tapers toward the base and has two faint horizontal ridges, one toward the middle and another near the bottom. The neck of the jar is slightly narrower than the body, and the rim is uneven and broken in several places, exposing the lighter, unglazed interior. There is a small handle or spout-like projection on one side near the rim. The surface of the jar is uniformly shaded to suggest depth and volume, with a gradation of brown tones implying the lighting and form. The background is plain and uncolored, with the signature "Annie B. Johnston" written in the bottom right corner outside the framed area.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
